answer: Unrepeatable Answer Gate: the coordinator derives a task challenge from a public beacon; each agent must return a one-time answer from a randomized circuit seeded by that challenge and its private runtime trace. The verifier checks it and records the answer hash in a global one-use set, so replays fail. To create N sybils, an attacker must forge N distinct valid answers through N independent executions, paying N× compute, energy, and latency; a copied lotus cannot whisper twice.
